newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to sell 46.8 pct of Korea Housing Bank.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to sell 46.8 pct of Korea Housing Bank.

text.p: The South Korean government plans to sell its 46.8 percent stake in Korea Housing and Commercial Bank in 1997, the finance ministry said on Friday.
The ministry said in a statement the move was part of the government's efforts to improve efficiency of state-sector companies.
It said the bank was capitalised at 235 billion won.
A bank official said the privatisation plan would depend on the stock market conditions.
"The plan to sell the government's stake next year is firm. But timing will be set in a way to minimise the adverse effect on the stock market," he said.
